summary: REGRESSION FULLY CLOSED. The iter25 silent-data-loss bug (1 of 4 transcripts dropped due to a parallel invocation hanging the save loop) is no longer reproducible after main agent's fix. With the inFlightRef.current useRef guard now wrapping runCombinedAnalysis (V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js lines 1133-1162: `if (inFlightRef.current) return; inFlightRef.current = true; try { ... } finally { inFlightRef.current = false; }`) AND the post-loop integrity check inside saveConnectTranscriptSessions (lines 488-502: synthesizes failure entries when savedSessions.length !== cleanSessions.length so silent data loss surfaces as 'Saved X/Y transcripts. Failed: ...' in the notice), the multi-transcript save flow is now deterministic. Verified end-to-end via Playwright + backend curl: (a) Fill 4 transcripts (132/134/136/132 chars) → click Analyze All once → exactly 4 POST /api/v3/meetings + 4 POST /transcript + 1 POST /analyze-all, all 200, ZERO hung XHRs, backend has 4 business_call meetings with t_len=131/133/135/135 (all non-empty); (b) Nav to /admin/business-cases then back to /connect/schedule → 4 editors hydrate WITH content (131/135/133/135 chars each); (c) Add 5th transcript + Analyze All → 4 PATCH /contact (existing meetings) + 5 POST /transcript (4 re-uploads + 1 new) + 1 POST /api/v3/meetings (only the new session) + 1 POST /analyze-all, all 200, 0 hung, backend has 5 non-empty meetings; (d) F5 reload → 5 editors render, all with non-empty content (132/131/135/133/135). The save notice on the happy path reads exactly 'AI analysis complete from the saved Connect transcripts.' with NO 'Saved X/Y' or 'Failed:' string. Anthropic remains out of credits (analysis_source=honest_fallback) — acceptable per brief. Backend cleaned up: 5 v3_meetings deleted at end of run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter26 confirmed the iter25 silent-data-loss regression is fully closed. Both fixes (inFlightRef synchronous useRef guard in runCombinedAnalysis + post-loop integrity check in saveConnectTranscriptSessions) are correctly implemented and verified end-to-end. The flow now reliably saves N transcripts in a single click with N POST /meetings (creates) + N POST /transcript + 1 POST /analyze-all (sequential, all 200, zero hung), and on re-save of existing + new sessions does N PATCH /contact (existing) + total_N POST /transcript + 1 POST /meetings (new only) + 1 POST /analyze-all. Hydration after nav-away or F5 always reflects backend state correctly. Remaining minor items are non-blocking (Anthropic credits out, write amplification on re-saves, missing DELETE endpoint). Anthropic honest_fallback is acceptable per task brief.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (CLOSED): The iter25 bug was a parallel-invocation race where React 18's microtask scheduling allowed runCombinedAnalysis to be entered twice before setAnalyzing(true)/setSaving(true) flipped the disabled prop, kicking off two interleaved save loops. The second loop's POST /api/v3/meetings for the same session collided with the first loop's POST and one of the two requests stalled (no response, no timeout). Net effect: 3 of 4 transcripts persisted, 1 was silently lost, the await chain hung forever, analyze-all never fired. MITIGATION VERIFIED: (1) inFlightRef.current useRef guard at lines 1133-1162 runs SYNCHRONOUSLY in the same JS tick as the entry, so any concurrent re-entry sees inFlightRef.current===true and bails immediately - this fully closes the race window that the setState-based disabled prop could not. (2) The post-loop integrity check at lines 488-502 ensures that even if a hung await ever does occur in the future, the user will see 'Saved X/Y transcripts. Failed: ...' in the notice instead of a silent loss. REPRODUCTION (iter25): 4-session save -> 3 persisted, 1 dropped, UI stuck on spinner, no error. CURRENT (iter26): same 4-session save -> 4 persisted, all non-empty, analyze-all fires, success notice rendered. Verified 2 runs in a row with clean network traces (no hung XHRs).
